member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.MedicalCause
member.remarks:
The causative agent(s) that are responsible for the pathophysiologic process that eventually results in a medical condition, symptom or sign. In this schema, unless otherwise specified this is meant to be the proximate cause of the medical condition, symptom or sign. The proximate cause is defined as the causative agent that most directly results in the medical condition, symptom or sign. For example, the HIV virus could be considered a cause of AIDS. Or in a diagnostic context, if a patient fell and sustained a hip fracture and two days later sustained a pulmonary embolism which eventuated in a cardiac arrest, the cause of the cardiac arrest (the proximate cause) would be the pulmonary embolism and not the fall.

Medical causes can include cardiovascular, chemical, dermatologic, endocrine, environmental, gastroenterologic, genetic, hematologic, gynecologic, iatrogenic, infectious, musculoskeletal, neurologic, nutritional, obstetric, oncologic, otolaryngologic, pharmacologic, psychiatric, pulmonary, renal, rheumatologic, toxic, traumatic, or urologic causes; medical conditions can be causes as well.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.SuperficialAnatomy
member.remarks: Anatomical features that can be observed by sight (without dissection), including the form and proportions of the human body as well as surface landmarks that correspond to deeper subcutaneous structures. Superficial anatomy plays an important role in sports medicine, phlebotomy, and other medical specialties as underlying anatomical structures can be identified through surface palpation. For example, during back surgery, superficial anatomy can be used to palpate and count vertebrae to find the site of incision. Or in phlebotomy, superficial anatomy can be used to locate an underlying vein; for example, the median cubital vein can be located by palpating the borders of the cubital fossa (such as the epicondyles of the humerus) and then looking for the superficial signs of the vein, such as size, prominence, ability to refill after depression, and feel of surrounding tissue support. As another example, in a subluxation (dislocation) of the glenohumeral joint, the bony structure becomes pronounced with the deltoid muscle failing to cover the glenohumeral joint allowing the edges of the scapula to be superficially visible. Here, the superficial anatomy is the visible edges of the scapula, implying the underlying dislocation of the joint (the related anatomical structure).

- Days are specified using the following two-letter combinations: Mo, Tu, We, Th, Fr, Sa, Su.
- Times are specified using 24:00 time. For example, 3pm is specified as 15:00.

The offer price of a product, or of a price component when attached to PriceSpecification and its subtypes.

Usage guidelines:
  • Use the priceCurrency property (with ISO 4217 codes e.g. "USD") instead of including ambiguous symbols such as '$' in the value.
  • Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.
  • Note that both RDFa and Microdata syntax allow the use of a "content=" attribute for publishing simple machine-readable values alongside more human-friendly formatting.
  • Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similiar Unicode symbols.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.priceSpecification

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.associatedArticle

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.producer

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.geographicArea

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.numberofEmployees
member.remarks: The size of business by number of employees.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.bloodSupply

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.drugClass

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.performer
member.remarks: A performer at the event—for example, a presenter, musician, musical group or actor.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.availableAtOrFrom

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.areaServed

member.remarks: A possible complication and/or side effect of this therapy. member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.costCategory
member.remarks: The category of cost, such as wholesale, retail, reimbursement cap, etc.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.stage

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.identifyingExam

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.typicalTest
member.remarks: A medical test typically performed given this condition.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.mapType
member.remarks: Indicates the kind of Map, from the MapCategoryType Enumeration.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.successorOf
member.remarks: A pointer from a newer variant of a product to its previous, often discontinued predecessor.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.pickupLocation
member.remarks: Where a taxi will pick up a passenger or a rental car can be picked up.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.dataset

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.nationality

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.sibling
member.remarks: A sibling of the person.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.itemReviewed

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.jobLocation
member.remarks: A (typically single) geographic location associated with the job position.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.suggestedAnswer
member.remarks: An answer (possibly one of several, possibly incorrect) to a Question, e.g. on a Question/Answer site.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.affectedBy
member.remarks: Drugs that affect the test's results.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.availableTest
member.remarks: A diagnostic test or procedure offered by this lab.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.instrument

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.organizer

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.dropoffLocation

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.servicePhone

member.remarks: An underlying cause. More specifically, one of the causative agent(s) that are most directly responsible for the pathophysiologic process that eventually results in the occurrence.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.usesDevice
member.remarks: Device used to perform the test.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.itemOffered
member.remarks: The item being offered.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.greater
member.remarks: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is greater than the object.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.partOfSystem
member.remarks: The anatomical or organ system that this structure is part of.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.partOfEpisode
member.remarks: The episode to which this clip belongs.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.isRelatedTo
member.remarks: A pointer to another, somehow related product (or multiple products).

member.remarks: A possible serious complication and/or serious side effect of this therapy. Serious adverse outcomes include those that are life-threatening; result in death, disability, or permanent damage; require hospitalization or prolong existing hospitalization; cause congenital anomalies or birth defects; or jeopardize the patient and may require medical or surgical intervention to prevent one of the outcomes in this definition.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.warrantyScope
member.remarks: The scope of the warranty promise.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.sourcedFrom
member.remarks: The neurological pathway that originates the neurons.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.hasPOS

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.purpose
member.remarks: A goal towards an action is taken. Can be concrete or abstract.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.video

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.follows

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.workPerformed

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.relevantSpecialty
member.remarks: If applicable, a medical specialty in which this entity is relevant.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.creator
member.remarks: The creator/author of this CreativeWork or UserComments. This is the same as the Author property for CreativeWork.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.yearsInOperation

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.worksFor

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.applicableLocation

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.endorsers

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.sensoryUnit

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.employee

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.availableChannel
member.remarks: A means of accessing the service (e.g. a phone bank, a web site, a location, etc.)

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.founder
member.remarks: A person who founded this organization.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.track

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.encodesCreativeWork

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.openingHoursSpecification

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.agent

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.connectedTo

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.originatesFrom

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.evidenceLevel

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.reservationFor

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.serviceAudience

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.billingAddress

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.programmingLanguage

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.serviceSmsNumber

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.inventoryLevel

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.season

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.departureBusStop

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.itemShipped

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.hoursAvailable

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.greaterOrEqual
member.remarks: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is greater than or equal to the object.

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.usedToDiagnose

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.productionCompany

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.departureAirport

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.relatedTo

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.illustrator

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.providesService

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.spouse

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.byArtist

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.cost

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.availableStrength

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.arrivalStation

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.children

member.name: F:Vocab.Schema.availableLanguage

member.name: T:Vocab.Sioc
member.remarks: SIOC (Semantically-Interlinked Online Communities) is an ontology for describing the information in online communities. This information can be used to export information from online communities and to link them together. The scope of the application areas that SIOC can be used for includes (and is not limited to) weblogs, message boards, mailing lists and chat channels.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.Forum
member.remarks: A discussion area on which Posts or entries are made.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.Post
member.remarks: An article or message that can be posted to a Forum.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.Site
member.remarks: A Site can be the location of an online community or set of communities, with UserAccounts and Usergroups creating Items in a set of Containers. It can be thought of as a web-accessible data Space.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.Thread
member.remarks: A container for a series of threaded discussion Posts or Items.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.UserAccount
member.remarks: A user account in an online community site.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.User
member.remarks: UserAccount is now preferred. This is a deprecated class for a User in an online community site.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.Community
member.remarks: Community is a high-level concept that defines an online community and what it consists of.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.Container
member.remarks: An area in which content Items are contained.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.Item
member.remarks: An Item is something which can be in a Container.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.Role
member.remarks: A Role is a function of a UserAccount within a scope of a particular Forum, Site, etc.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.Space
member.remarks: A Space is a place where data resides, e.g. on a website, desktop, fileshare, etc.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.Usergroup
member.remarks: A set of UserAccounts whose owners have a common purpose or interest. Can be used for access control purposes.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.avatar
member.remarks: An image or depiction used to represent this UserAccount.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.has_reply
member.remarks: Points to an Item or Post that is a reply or response to this Item or Post.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.last_activity_date
member.remarks: The date and time of the last activity associated with a SIOC concept instance, and expressed in ISO 8601 format. This could be due to a reply Post or Comment, a modification to an Item, etc.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.last_item_date
member.remarks: The date and time of the last Post (or Item) in a Forum (or a Container), in ISO 8601 format.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.last_reply_date
member.remarks: The date and time of the last reply Post or Comment, which could be associated with a starter Item or Post or with a Thread, and expressed in ISO 8601 format.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.links_to
member.remarks: Links extracted from hyperlinks within a SIOC concept, e.g. Post or Site.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.next_version
member.remarks: Links to the next revision of this Item or Post.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.previous_version
member.remarks: Links to the previous revision of this Item or Post.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.reply_of
member.remarks: Links to an Item or Post which this Item or Post is a reply to.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.topic
member.remarks: A topic of interest, linking to the appropriate URI, e.g. in the Open Directory Project or of a SKOS category.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.content
member.remarks: The content of the Item in plain text format.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.email_sha1
member.remarks: An electronic mail address of the UserAccount, encoded using SHA1.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.id
member.remarks: An identifier of a SIOC concept instance. For example, a user ID. Must be unique for instances of each type of SIOC concept within the same site.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.ip_address
member.remarks: The IP address used when creating this Item. This can be associated with a creator. Some wiki articles list the IP addresses for the creator or modifiers when the usernames are absent.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.name
member.remarks: The name of a SIOC concept instance, e.g. a username for a UserAccount, group name for a Usergroup, etc.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.note
member.remarks: A note associated with this resource, for example, if it has been edited by a UserAccount.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.num_authors
member.remarks: The number of unique authors (UserAccounts and unregistered posters) who have contributed to this Item, Thread, Post, etc.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.num_items
member.remarks: The number of Posts (or Items) in a Forum (or a Container).

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.num_replies
member.remarks: The number of replies that this Item, Thread, Post, etc. has. Useful for when the reply structure is absent.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.num_threads

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.num_views
member.remarks: The number of times this Item, Thread, UserAccount profile, etc. has been viewed.

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.title

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.content_encoded

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.created_at

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.description

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.first_name

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.last_name

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.modified_at

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.container_of

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.email

member.name: F:Vocab.Sioc.has_function

member.name: T:Vocab.Skos
member.remarks: An RDF vocabulary for describing the basic structure and content of concept schemes such as thesauri, classification schemes, subject heading lists, taxonomies, 'folksonomies', other types of controlled vocabulary, and also concept schemes embedded in glossaries and terminologies.

member.name: F:Vocab.Skos.OrderedCollection
member.remarks: Ordered collections can be used where you would like a set of concepts to be displayed in a specific order, and optionally under a 'node label'.

member.name: F:Vocab.Skos.ConceptScheme
member.remarks: A concept scheme may be defined to include concepts from different sources.
member.example: Thesauri, classification schemes, subject heading lists, taxonomies, 'folksonomies', and other types of controlled vocabulary are all examples of concept schemes. Concept schemes are also embedded in glossaries and terminologies.

member.name: F:Vocab.Skos.Collection
member.remarks: Labelled collections can be used where you would like a set of concepts to be displayed under a 'node label' in the hierarchy.

member.name: F:Vocab.Skos.topConceptOf
member.summary: is top concept in scheme property

member.name: F:Vocab.Skos.prefLabel
member.remarks: A resource has no more than one value of skos:prefLabel per language tag, and no more than one value of skos:prefLabel without language tag.

member.name: F:Vocab.Skos.altLabel
member.remarks: The range of skos:altLabel is the class of RDF plain literals.
member.example: Acronyms, abbreviations, spelling variants, and irregular plural/singular forms may be included among the alternative labels for a concept. Mis-spelled terms are normally included as hidden labels (see skos:hiddenLabel).

member.name: F:Vocab.Skos.hiddenLabel
member.remarks: The range of skos:hiddenLabel is the class of RDF plain literals.

member.name: F:Vocab.Skos.broader
member.remarks: By convention, skos:broader is only used to assert an immediate (i.e. direct) hierarchical link between two conceptual resources.

member.name: F:Vocab.Skos.narrower
member.remarks: By convention, skos:broader is only used to assert an immediate (i.e. direct) hierarchical link between two conceptual resources.

member.name: F:Vocab.Skos.related
member.remarks: skos:related is disjoint with skos:broaderTransitive

member.name: F:Vocab.Skos.broaderTransitive
member.remarks: By convention, skos:broaderTransitive is not used to make assertions. Rather, the properties can be used to draw inferences about the transitive closure of the hierarchical relation, which is useful e.g. when implementing a simple query expansion algorithm in a search application.

member.name: F:Vocab.Skos.narrowerTransitive
member.remarks: By convention, skos:narrowerTransitive is not used to make assertions. Rather, the properties can be used to draw inferences about the transitive closure of the hierarchical relation, which is useful e.g. when implementing a simple query expansion algorithm in a search application.

member.name: F:Vocab.Skos.mappingRelation
member.summary: is in mapping relation with property
member.remarks: These concept mapping relations mirror semantic relations, and the data model defined below is similar (with the exception of skos:exactMatch) to the data model defined for semantic relations. A distinct vocabulary is provided for concept mapping relations, to provide a convenient way to differentiate links within a concept scheme from links between concept schemes. However, this pattern of usage is not a formal requirement of the SKOS data model, and relies on informal definitions of best practice.

member.name: F:Vocab.Skos.exactMatch
member.remarks: skos:exactMatch is disjoint with each of the properties skos:broadMatch and skos:relatedMatch.

member.name: F:Vocab.Skos.note
member.remarks: This property may be used directly, or as a super-property for more specific note types.

member.name: F:Vocab.Skos.notation
member.remarks: By convention, skos:notation is used with a typed literal in the object position of the triple.

member.name: F:Vocab.Skos.inScheme
member.remarks: A concept may be a member of more than one concept scheme.

member.name: F:Vocab.Skos.semanticRelation
member.summary: is in semantic relation with property
member.remarks: This property should not be used directly, but as a super-property for all properties denoting a relationship of meaning between concepts.

member.name: F:Vocab.Skos.memberList
member.remarks: For any resource, every item in the list given as the value of the skos:memberList property is also a value of the skos:member property.
